default_font.label: Default font
default_font.hint: ID of a font: component used to render text and symbols where a widget does not set its own text_font. Defaults to LVGL's built-in montserrat_14.

default_group.label: Default group
default_group.hint: Name of the input group that new widgets join automatically, so an encoder or keypad can navigate them.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Global style defaults per widget type. Keyed by widget type, optionally nested by part and state.

disp_bg_color.label: Display background color
disp_bg_color.hint: Fill color of the whole display behind all widgets.

disp_bg_image.label: Display background image
disp_bg_image.hint: ID of an image: component drawn as the display background.

disp_bg_opa.label: Display background opacity
disp_bg_opa.hint: Opacity of the display background color/image, 0-255 or a percentage.

transparency_key.label: Transparency key
transparency_key.hint: Color treated as fully transparent when the display buffer is composited (chroma key).

color_depth.label: Color depth
color_depth.hint: Bits per pixel of the LVGL draw buffer. Must match the connected display.

full_refresh.label: Full refresh
full_refresh.hint: Redraw the entire screen every frame instead of only changed areas. Needed for some displays, costs performance.

style_definitions.label: Style definitions
style_definitions.hint: Reusable named style blocks that widgets can reference by ID instead of repeating properties.

bg_color.hint: Background fill color of this part.

bg_opa.hint: Background opacity, 0-255 or a percentage. TRANSP hides the fill.

bg_grad_color.hint: Second color for a background gradient, blended from bg_color along bg_grad_dir.

border_width.hint: Border thickness in pixels. 0 disables the border.

radius.hint: Corner radius in pixels. A large value on a square widget makes it a circle.

text_font.label: Text font
text_font.hint: ID of the font: component used for this widget's text. Falls back to the LVGL default_font.

pad_all.hint: Inner padding on all four sides in pixels.

shadow_width.hint: Blur radius of the drop shadow in pixels. 0 disables the shadow.

opa.hint: Overall opacity of the widget, 0-255 or a percentage.

align.hint: Anchor point of the widget relative to its parent (e.g. CENTER, TOP_LEFT).

long_mode.hint: How a label handles text longer than its width: WRAP, DOT, SCROLL, SCROLL_CIRCULAR or CLIP.
